route: native fresh reviewer; canonical route helper unavailable

findings.decision: Fatal failures during tool-result waiting leave dead sessions occupying capacity.
findings.why_it_matters: Once a tool response is returned there is no active collector. ACP exit or MCP disconnection only queues an error; four such failures can exhaust the default process capacity until TTL.
findings.status: Conflicts with A-009 and documented cleanup; fixed by immediate server disposal on fatal transport errors. Verified with real official child process SIGKILL.

findings.decision: Tool arguments bypass the configured output limit.
findings.why_it_matters: Events delivered directly to a waiting collector bypass queuedBytes; the collection response-size check covered only text, not tool arguments.
findings.status: Conflicts with A-009; fixed combined text and serialized tool budget. Direct-waiter regression check passed.

findings.decision: Agent request-budget exhaustion is reported as token exhaustion.
findings.why_it_matters: ACP max_turn_requests became OpenAI length and Anthropic max_tokens, misleading callers about the stop reason.
findings.status: Added A-014 and changed to explicit upstream_error; regression check passed.

rounds.reviewer_note: The continuation mechanism does resume the original pending MCP call through Bridge.resolve() while retaining the original ACP prompt; it does not reconstruct a fake tool exchange. Anthropic is_error maps to MCP isError, and OpenAI text results map to MCP text content. Token limits, role priority, serial tool delivery, schema validation, and native-tool isolation limitations are explicitly documented. Actual model identity unknown; this review does not establish cross-family independence or constitute an independent acceptance pass.

recheck.verdict: two lifecycle findings; fixed after final review by executor
findings: Concurrent dispose callers could release capacity before initial cleanup completed. Fixed Session.close() to return one shared cleanup promise; held-cleanup regression passed.
Buffered-output overflow bypassed server disposal and could permanently retain capacity. Fixed overflow path to call onFatal; overflow callback regression passed.
recheck.limitation: Round budget exhausted. Last lifecycle fixes verified by executor only, not independently re-reviewed. Actual reviewer model identity unknown.
